data.entranceFeeDescription: $15.00 per adult (16 years and older). Purchase in advance with your parking/shuttle reservation or upon arrival at the Muir Woods Visitor Center. Parking/shuttle reservation fees are separate from entrance fees and are required for all vehicles and shuttle riders. Visit GoMuirWoods.com to reserve parking/shuttle tickets and pre-purchase entrance fees.

fees.description: $15 per person 16 years of age and older. Entrance fees may be purchased in advance with your parking/shuttle reservation or upon arrival to the park. Parking/shuttle reservations are required for all vehicles and shuttle riders visiting Muir Woods National Monument. Reservation fees are separate from entrance fees. Please visit GoMuirWoods.com for parking/shuttle reservations.

passes.description: This pass is good for 12 months. It admits the pass holder and three persons (16 and older) to Muir Woods. A physical card can be purchased at Muir Woods -OR- a digital version of the Muir Woods Annual Pass can be purchased on recreation.gov. Parking reservations are required for all visitors.
